title: The Smile Sessions
notes:
The box set is primarily mono. LP2 Side 4, the Bonus Tracks on the first CD (Tracks 20–27), as well as some backing instruments on the other CDs are stereo.

Tracks 1-28, 3-27, 3-28, 4-25 and 5-25 are hidden tracks.

Box with 3-D shadow box version of the Smile album cover.

2 180-Gram Vinyl LPs in a gatefold cover - exact reproduction of original front and back art.

12 page photo booklet and a 24"x36" poster of original album cover art.

Double-foldout printed cardstock "slipcase" containing two 7" singles with covers and five CDs.

60 page hardbound book with essays, lyrics, sessionography, original artwork, previously unreleased photos and more.

Clear sticker on rear shrink wrap:
Printed in U.S.A.
Made in Mexico
